notes:
August 31th 2026
Version 13.7+ (stable) / 13.8+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Volume Mixer: Live/Realtime when USB connected (R).
* Reed mixer: set each accordion reed on its own, right hand and left. (R)
* Mixer strips are now grouped by right hand, left hand and drums. (R)
* Print your program list with each program's loudest level, for comparison. (R)
* Volume Mixer now fits smaller screens, with minimise and maximise buttons. (R)
* Volume Mixer: every section's level side by side, like a mixing desk. (R)
* Normalize one program with a before-and-after preview. (R)
* Programs needing an expansion pack you don't have are now marked in the list. (R)
* Expansion Pack Usage now suggests the best four packs for your file. (R)
* New Window menu - jump between open windows with Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2... (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...

September 2nd 2026
Version 13.7+ (stable) / 13.8+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Drum links now carry across between the FR-8x and FR-4x. (R)
* Much smaller download and install - the guides now come from the web. (K,R)
* Reed sliders now show which reeds the chosen register has switched off. (R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
